listing.name: Adjustable Automated Ships
listing.summary: Allows the player to customize the maximum deployment value for automated ships in their fleet.
listing.aiSummary: Allows the player to customize the maximum deployment value for automated ships in their fleet.

description:
Adjustable Automated Ships

is a simple mod which allows the player to specify the maximum deployment value of automated ships in the player's fleet, rather than using the hardcoded value of 30. By default, this is set to 50 - just enough to deploy a single Radiant battleship commanded by an alpha core - but the value can be adjusted in automation_config.json.
